The same tautology exists in updateEvent (`event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`). Previously the fallback was `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`, so legacy bookings without externalCalendarId would now pass an undefined calendarId instead of the destination calendar id, breaking deletion/update of those events.

judged_text: Google deleteEvent: tautological lookup comparing cal.externalId against the externalCalendarId parameter itself; when externalCalendarId is falsy calendarId is undefined and legacy bookings' events are not deleted, leaving orphaned events (CalendarService.ts:312-315)
